title: The house on the rock
author: Jesus, in the Gospel of Matthew
lines: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.
The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
why: The last words of the Sermon on the Mount: hearing is not enough; only doing builds a life that stands.

title: In deed and truth
author: John
lines: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
why: One line that sums up the Sermon's demand: love is something done, not only said.
